name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentations that actually look human-crafted, not auto-generated.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce generic, visually bland slides that undermine credibility in professional settings. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the 'AI slop' problem by giving users smart assistance while preserving design quality and creative control. Teams need decks that impress stakeholders, not outputs that scream template automation.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with polished, non-generic visuals
Creating client-facing sales presentations that reflect brand standards
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks quickly without sacrificing quality
Generating thought-leadership or conference presentation slides with a distinctive look
